covers: JSE close and the first two and a half hours of the US session, 19 Nov 2026
headline: Wall Street selling deepens: S&P 500 down to 7,220.89 and Nasdaq to 24,118.04 at 19:09 SAST; AMD -8.4%; rand R17.48/$
summary: The JSE All Share closed at 106,216.5 on 19 Nov 2026, 5.5% lower on the week, and the rand weakened further to R17.48 per dollar by 19:09 SAST after the SARB held the repo rate at 7.25% on a 4–3 vote (LRC Market Dashboard; BusinessTech, 19 Nov 2026). In New York the fall extended: at 19:09 SAST the S&P 500 was at 7,220.89, down from 7,309.85 at 18:02 and 4.5% lower on the week, and the Nasdaq at 24,118.04, with AMD down 8.4% and Nvidia, Meta, Amazon and Apple each 1.3–1.5% lower, while Palo Alto Networks (+5.3%) held its results-day gain (LRC Market Dashboard and Stock Scanner quotes, 19:09 SAST). Gold was at $3,685.80 and Brent at $89.92, with the US 10-year yield at 5.07%; the deeper sell-off keeps pressure on risk assets and the rand into the 23:00 SAST US close.

items.summary: An hour earlier (18:02 SAST) the S&P 500 was at 7,309.85 and the Nasdaq at 24,501.91, a further fall of about 1.2% and 1.6%. AMD was down 8.4% to $485.70 at 19:09 SAST; Nvidia -1.3% ($149.00), Meta -1.4%, Amazon -1.5%, Apple -1.5%. Ratings unchanged (LRC Market Dashboard and Stock Scanner quotes, 19 Nov 2026).

items.title: SARB holds repo rate at 7.25%; MPC split 4–3, with three votes for a hike
items.summary: The Reserve Bank kept the repo rate at 7.25% on 19 Nov 2026. Four members voted to hold and three for a 25bp increase. Kganyago said near-term inflation is above 5%, in line with this week's 5.2% CPI reading, and that high prints are expected to last into early next year before easing. He said the committee is pausing "for now" and "will not hesitate to raise rates if needed" to bring inflation back to the 3% target. The close vote keeps a further hike on the table at the next meeting.
